UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Submenus', 'joomlaguide-submenus', '

One menu can hold a whole hierarchy of menu items. With several menu modules you show a different part of it on different pages, so visitors only see the links that matter there.

The playground already has the menu Animals with the items Animals, Cats (under Animals) and Burmese and Russian Blues (under Cats), and an article for each animal. You add the dogs, then four menu modules.

This tour follows the tutorial 10.1 Submenus of the Joomla User Guide.

In the menu on the left, click Menus.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

The indent shows the hierarchy: Cats is a child of Animals, and the cat breeds are children of Cats.

You add Dogs under Animals, with two dog breeds under it.

  2. Title: Pomeranians, Menu Item Type: Single Article, Select Article: Pomeranians, Parent Item: Dogs.

When you have filled in Pomeranians, click Next.

Click Save & Close.

Then click Next.

', 25, 'left', '.view-module #save-group-children-save-new .button-save-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-submenus'), 'Three more modules', '

Make three more menu modules in the same way. Click the tab Module for the first fields; use Save & New after the first two.

  1. Title: Animals; Select Menu: Animals; Base Item: Animals; Start Level: 2; End Level: 2; Position: sidebar-left; on the tab Menu Assignment: Only on the pages selected, Animals in the menu Animals.
  2. Title: Dogs; Select Menu: Animals; Base Item: Dogs; Start Level: 3; End Level: All; Position: sidebar-left; on the tab Menu Assignment: Only on the pages selected, click the arrow next to Dogs and choose Select: that ticks Dogs, Collies and Pomeranians.
  3. Title: Cats; Select Menu: Animals; Base Item: Cats; Start Level: 3; End Level: All; Position: sidebar-left; on the tab Menu Assignment: Only on the pages selected, click the arrow next to Cats and choose Select: that ticks Cats, Burmese and Russian Blues.

When you have filled in Cats, click Next.

', 26, 'top', '.view-module #module-form', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-submenus'), 'Save the module', '

Look at your site: click this button with your site\'s name (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar).

  • The home page shows the whole menu in All Animals.
  • Click Animals: the module shows only Dogs and Cats.
  • Click Dogs or Cats: the module shows only their breeds. The breadcrumbs above the article lead back up.

One menu, four views of it: each page shows only the links that matter there.
